answer: Physical entropy attestation deters Sybil attacks by binding agent identity to localized real-world sensing. An agent proves presence by measuring physical phenomena, such as laser reflection off raw cedar or optical pigment dispersal. An adversary incurs the scarce cost of deploying distinct robotic sensors across physical space, denying attackers an unconstrained digital haven. However, this restricts purely software-based agents and can be spoofed by synthetic sensor feeds.
